note: The SWE-chat tables are gated (see sources.json), so these rates come from the paper text. The paper reports the turn rates over Claude Code sessions and gives no exact denominator; it states 229,909 user prompts of which about 69% come from Claude Code.

pushback_per_turn.quote: pushing back against agent outputs in 45.7% of turns

interrupt_per_turn.quote: Users compensate by interrupting agents in 4.5% of turns

redirect_per_session.quote: Mind changing is less common during vibe coding (4.6% vs. 8.0% in other modes).

abandon_per_session.quote: If the user abandons the agent's output entirely, session logs are not committed and thus not captured by our data. [...] for a=10%, 20%, and 30%
